Alice: Heads-up — proposing cut for release v2026.03.18 on Thu 2026-03-18 17:30 UTC (shifted from 18:00). Need confirmations for: canary owners, rollback plan, infra oncall, docs freeze, QA smoke. If you're a stakeholder, reply with ✅ or your availability.

Ben: ✅ I'm in for 17:30. I'll own canary verification (will run the smoke + perf checks).

Carla_M: Docs freeze is fine from my side. Final docs PR list by EOD Wed.

Dmitri: SRE oncall that window is me. I'll reserve infra and prep rollback hooks.

Erin: Quick note — I had a calendar conflict at 18:00 so 17:30 works better for me, thanks for shifting.

Alice: Great — 17:30 locked unless new objections. Need one more confirmation from infra team for GPU reservation and from QA on smoke slot.

Ben: I'll post the canary checklist in a sec.

deploy-bot: deploy-watchlist created: #release-watchers, canary tag = rc-0318. Auto-reminder set for 60m before cut.

Dmitri: Draft agenda (please add owners):
```
- 16:45 UTC: Pre-cut infra readiness check (SRE + infra)
- 17:00 UTC: QA smoke window open (QA lead runs tests)
- 17:20 UTC: Final PR checklist & docs freeze confirmation
- 17:30 UTC: Cut decision & deploy (small batch)
- 17:40 UTC: Canary monitoring (10% traffic) — 15m
- 17:55 UTC: Rollout or rollback decision
- 18:05 UTC: Post-cut smoke & stakeholder signoff
```

Alice: Owners proposal: Ben -> canary verification, Carla_M -> docs & release notes, Dmitri -> rollback hooks & infra, Erin -> stakeholder comms. QA lead please confirm.

Ben: Canary checklist (short):
```
canary-checklist:
- latency p50 < 200ms for chat endpoints
- error-rate < 0.5%
- embeddings throughput within expected bounds
- run sample user flows: chat conversational + long-context + embeddings batch
- sanity prompts pass (no hallucination spike)
```

Carla_M: PRs to merge before cut: #1234, #1241, #1250. I will cut docs at 16:30 UTC and update release notes with those PRs.

Dmitri: @infra-team please confirm GPU pool reservation for smoke and canary.

infra-bot: GPU reservation confirmed: 2x A100 reserved in pool 'dedicated-cut-0318', expires 20:00 UTC. Network egress rules updated for canary namespace.

Erin: I'll be on standby for stakeholder comms and post-cut emails.

Alice: If there are no objections by 17:00 UTC tomorrow, we'll lock 17:30 cut and I'll update the calendar invite with the agenda and owners. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're an owner and will attend.

Ben: 👍

Carla_M: :thumbsup:

Dmitri: 👍

Erin: 👍

Alice: Thanks — I'll also add a contingency note to the invite for an immediate rollback window (15m) and include the rollback command snippet.

Ben: Posting canary verification runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/runbooks/canary-rc-0318

Dmitri: I'll schedule the smoke test slot in the QA calendar and ping the QA lead.

Alice: Perfect. Lastly, quick owner checklist to confirm in thread (one-line each): canary, rollback, docs, QA, infra.

Carla_M: docs - confirmed.

Ben: canary - confirmed.
